name: beehiiv
description: beehiiv is a newsletter publishing platform for creating, distributing, and analyzing email publications and their audiences.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact beehiiv organization through Relay-owned OAuth, then let agents inspect approval-gated, bounded organization, publication, and post lifecycle metadata without subscriber identity, publication content, or engagement.

capabilities.label: Read newsletter lifecycle metadata
capabilities.description: Read bounded, redacted organization, publication, and post lifecycle metadata.

approvalRequired.label: Read OAuth account summary
approvalRequired.description: Read the exact beehiiv organization identifier and token lifetime without returning user identity.

approvalRequired.label: List publication lifecycle
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five publication lifecycle summaries without names, organizations, URLs, or engagement statistics.

approvalRequired.label: List post lifecycle
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five post lifecycle summaries for one exact publication without content, titles, authors, URLs, or engagement.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every bounded beehiiv metadata read requires approval; subscriber identity, content, engagement, automations, segments, polls, tiers, referrals, webhooks, writes, exports, and raw API access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The three bounded beehiiv metadata reads run without Relay per-action approval; exact-organization binding, fixed origins, redaction, first-page bounds, audits, and rate limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts three exact-organization, approval-aware beehiiv metadata reads and attaches the OAuth token server-side.
Relay mounts three exact-organization, approval-aware beehiiv metadata reads and attaches the OAuth token server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's beehiiv OAuth client and production credentials are not configured yet; client registration requires beehiiv Support.
providerSetup.nextAction: Using the separate provider-console task, register Relay's confidential OAuth client with the Railway callback through beehiiv Support, store BEEHIIV_CLIENT_ID and BEEHIIV_CLIENT_SECRET in Railway, deploy, and run live consent, refresh, exact-organization reads, policy, upstream revocation, and post-disconnect denial checks.

evidence.supports: beehiiv documents confidential authorization-code OAuth, space-delimited scopes, refresh tokens, token info, introspection, revocation, and Support-assisted client registration.
beehiiv documents the publications:read list endpoint, fixed API origin, bearer authentication, pagination, and optional engagement expansions that Relay excludes.
beehiiv documents the posts:read publication-bound list endpoint and content, author, title, URL, and stats fields that Relay strips.
beehiiv documents a 180-request-per-minute per-organization limit and rate-limit response headers.

securityNotes: Relay requests only identify:read, publications:read, and posts:read; all write and subscriber scopes are excluded.
Relay stores access and refresh tokens encrypted, binds the grant to token-info resource_owner_id, and never returns secrets to agents.

Runtime requests use only https://app.beehiiv.com OAuth utilities and https://api.beehiiv.com API reads, reject redirects, cap responses at 2 MB, and throttle to no more than 180 requests per minute per organization.
Publication output excludes names, organization names, URLs, and stats; post output excludes title, subtitle, subject, preview, authors, slugs, URLs, content, premium tiers, and engagement.
Disconnect revokes the refresh token upstream before deleting Relay's encrypted grant.
